name: enable_automatic_battle_music_switching

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_EnableAutomaticBattleMusicSwitching takes no Script context and calls func_0011E350 without accessing the value stack

notes: func_0011E350 clears suppression flag D_002BD8E0, allowing func_0011E360 to resume automatic field/battle music channel crossfades when battle mode changes. It is the inverse of command 719. The JP corpus has no calls.
